title: Main window
brief: Improve the sdeck-plus main window: less vertical chrome, a clearer editor/catalog split, and room for the longer Multimedia catalog (new microphone actions) while keeping the app's dark charcoal/violet/cyan system.

artboards.title: Compact shell
artboards.tradeoff: One header bar (title, status, profiles, tools); page strip joins the preview column; catalog groups audio by Output / Input. Saves ~90px of height; tabs and tools share one row so narrow widths need an overflow menu.

artboards.title: Inspector first
artboards.tradeoff: Editor merges into one inspector with Binding / Actions / Dials tabs; the preview gets the whole left column. Fewer panels and a clear job per tab; the catalog needs one extra click when browsing.

artboards.title: Profile rail
artboards.tradeoff: Profiles move to a vertical rail, categories become filter chips and audio is grouped Media / Output / Input. Scales to many profiles; needs 1200px+ and a stacked layout below that.
